name: Openlands Official
goals: Ship Official ECHO Pack #2 as a relaxed vanilla-style experience without copyrighted Minecraft assets or branding.
Use echoopenlandsprotocol as the shared data source for Native, Standalone, and NeoForge outputs.
Validate a first-hour loop built around gathering, shelter, sleeping, exploration, old roads, and first waystone restoration.
description: Official Openlands profile for ECHO: a relaxed block-survival sandbox about homesteads, roads, regions, and waystones.
targetPlayer: Players who want a familiar, welcoming block-sandbox loop with better building flow, clearer progression, map discovery, and optional co-op.
gameplayLoop: Gather starter resources, craft tools, build a forgiving shelter, sleep safely, follow old roads, restore waystones, expand a homestead, farm, trade, and explore deeper regions.
first30Minutes: Spawn near wood, loose stone, fiber, food, water, and one exploration hook.
Collect branchwood, fieldstone, reed fiber, and starter food.
Craft fiber binding, a crude tool, a campfire, and a workbench.
Build or adapt a forgiving shelter with roof coverage, enclosure, light, and bedroll.
Sleep to set a return point and complete the first shelter milestone.
first2Hours: Discover a road marker, tiny camp, ruin, cave mouth, or broken waystone.
Use the map table and HoloMap data to record a region rubbing.
Repair a broken waystone through debris cleared and stone repaired states.
Build a kiln, craft bricks/glass/charcoal, and begin metal progression.
Start grain, roots, berries, animal pens, or trader surplus depending on available modules.
notRecommendedFor: Packs that need copied vanilla mob or block identity

wizardCopy.summary: Relaxed Openlands sandbox profile with building, farming, old roads, waystones, HoloMap discovery, and cross-runtime parity.
warnings: Hardlands is optional and must not change the Standard default.
All assets and names must be original Openlands content.
